proof.preconditions: IEEE binary32/binary64, RNE, DAZ/FTZ off, masked exceptions, strict noncontracting vector arithmetic.
proof.normal_input_domain: All eight lanes: unbiased eA,eB in[-103,60], |a|,|b|<=2^60, eA+eB>=-80. Individual biased exponents>=24 and their sum>=174.
proof.split: Original4097 split is exact with no scaling overflow/underflow. Each input is a multiple of2^(e-23)>=2^-126, as are its split components; all nonzero components are normal. Smaller normal inputs can have exact subnormal split lows (for example0x00800001); the stricter individual exponent guard retains the original path and its denormal-operand flag.
proof.partial_products: Each split component is a multiple of its original2^(e-23) lattice. Each nonzero cross-product is a multiple of2^(eA+eB-46)>=2^-126. All five original product magnitudes remain below2^123, so none overflows or rounds through underflow.
proof.equality: Original TwoProduct has high=RN32(a*b), low=a*b-high exactly in this domain. A binary64 significand holds the exact at-most48-bit binary32 product. Its subtraction of the same original float high is exact; the resulting nonzero residual is exactly representable as binary32. Thus both original primitive words are identical.
proof.zero: Any zero residual in any lane takes the entire original chain, retaining all zero signs. Example0x3f800fff*2 has original low=-0 while wide exact cancellation gives+0.
proof.exceptions: Every fast lane has nonzero residual, so the retained original high multiplication already raises inexact. The skipped original chain can raise no other exception in this domain; all wide operations/conversions are exact. Any fallback executes the unchanged original chain.
proof.inactive_and_unknown: Whole-eight guard includes inactive lanes. Integer-only bounds reject zero, subnormal, Inf/NaN and excessive operands before any new FP operation; every other vector retains original execution. No active masks, operand loading, aliasing writes, identity tests, metadata or caller operations change.

reference.role: Original split/TwoProduct exact identity when product underflow is excluded; bounds and binary64 equivalence above are this source derivation.

performance_scope: The fast branch replaces17 binary32 arithmetic operations with one original binary32 multiply, two binary64 operations and four exact vector conversions, plus integer bounds/branches. It reaches three product32 calls per general multiply and the original repeated multiply calls inside divide/sqrt. Actual whole-eight/nonzero-residual hit rate, code/register/stack effects and benefit are unmeasured; mixed exceptional/zero vectors retain the old chain. No claim that this alone closes the~3.5x frame gap.
scope: One internal primitive only in a separately derived optional-v4 source. Original retained8.cpp, original-v3 object, baseline dispatcher, five-word ABI, eight32-bit lanes, all operations outside product32, refinements, masks, error allowance, raw3/scalar/provider/host/SPIRV and acceptance criteria are unchanged. No compiler execution, link, test, profiling, provider mutation or qualification claim.
